about_the_game:
A story, a wish

Everything seems just ordinary

But fulfilling a wish always comes with a price

Yet we enjoy dreaming dreams that we don't want to awaken from in our daily lives

But this time 'I' hope to bring 'you' home

The visual novel [30 DAYS of Raising RaN] is now in demo testing.

This Demo will showcase 65% of the game's progress compared to the full version in order to verify the feasibility of the storyline.

We welcome you to try it out and provide your valuable feedback.

Please note that this Demo only supports the Chinese language.

Thank you for your understanding.

『Game Introduction』

Every day, tormented by illness, you encounter her in an alley.

She says her name is Ran, and she wants to spend a few days in your home.

For some reason, you agree to her request.

You know that 30 days is long for her, yet also very short.

Sometimes you wish this was just a dream.

Sometimes you wish this was something truly real.

What is real? What is fake?

Does it really... matter?

Do you really have to make a "choice"?

『Character』

RaN

Preferences: Milk

Dislikes: Bright lights, being disturbed while sleeping

"How are you?"

Transformed from a kitten into a human

The peculiarities about her go unnoticed by othersShe seems to know everything about you; she always hopes you can live a more normal life

30 days is a long time for her

She has waited for you for too long...

TARS

A companion who calls themselves 'pointer'

Only appears after DAY 20

She will bring you more branching options to rewrite the ending

『Have you really forgotten me?』

『Even you have forgotten me??』

A few notes:

As an independent game, there are still many shortcomings in this visual novel, and the sparse CG images and illustrations will be followed up later.

As an independent game, this game follows the CC0/CC-BY license, and the sources of the materials have been credited within the game.

Special thanks to the character illustrator ChiOrange and the Bilibili uploader HuanJianLiLuo, as well as Ren'Py tutorials from the forever Queen of the Sky.

Thanks also to all members who participated in the game testing.

Thank you for playing this work.

       Sincerely,

XiAoRaN

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Any Linux
  • Processor: As long as it can power on.
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: As long as it can light up the screen.
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: As long as it works.
  • VR Support: Not support VR
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel i5 6300U and adove
  • Memory: 6144 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 520 and above
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: No special requirements
  • VR Support: Not support VR
